Thanks for the ping — quick product/legal notes from my side:
- Capacity mapping: monthly committed units (MCU) are consumed first; burst applies per rolling 24h window and is billed at the overage rate stated in Exhibit C. Overage kicks in once both MCU and burst bucket are exhausted. I'll attach a simple worked example separately.
- Legal redline suggestion: replace the broad "audit log" phrase in 7.2 with "per-request ephemeral logs (retained up to N days)" and a cross-reference to the Data Processing Addendum for access controls. That keeps us compliant with SOC2 while addressing their ask.

If Emma wants the 30-day hard cap, we should accept that and tie the exception to a written request for longer retention with explicit business justification.

Karthik
Senior Product Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
